title: 1.10 Pets
unit_outcome: Understand and produce simple sentences about people, family members, and actions.
goal: Name four family pets and say what each one is doing.
grammar_function: A + animal; The + animal + is + action; The + animal + is a pet; They are pets; The + person + and the + animal + are + action.
prerequisite: Lessons 1.1-1.7: a, the, is, are, they, and, girl, and the actions running, sleeping, drinking, eating and playing.
speaking_outcome: Name a dog, a cat, a bird and a rabbit, say what each one is doing, and say that they are pets.
